content:
With just weeks until its premiere, Apple TV has today released the trailer for the second season of "Women in Blue" — watch it below.

"Women in Blue" returns on August 12

Almost exactly two years ago, "Women in Blue" (Las Azules) debuted on Apple TV, with a 10-episode first season.

The Spanish-language crime drama, per Apple TV, "follows four women who defy the era's deeply conservative social norms to join Mexico's first female police force — only to discover it is a public relations ploy meant to distract the media from a brutal serial killer."

"Women in Blue" is inspired by real events. The show was renewed for season 2 back in May 2025, and a premiere date — August 12 — was announced later.

Today Apple TV unveiled the trailer for the second season, and says the Azules will investigate a murder connected to the 1968 student massacre.
